response: Saved Views is available today, giving you a faster way to work with the lists and boards you use most. Instead of rebuilding filters and sorting every time, save the exact configuration you want—by assignee, priority, due date, or any combination—and return to it in a single click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so every team already gets full access with no add-on required. Each user can save up to 50 views, covering personal workflows, recurring reports, and everything in between. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to align on the same filtered perspective during planning, stand-ups, or reviews. Whether you're tracking overdue tasks, monitoring a sprint, or organizing work by owner, Saved Views keeps your setup ready whenever you need it. Give it a try on your next project and see how much time it saves your team. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
